summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, announcing completion of its court-approved plan of arrangement acquisition of all outstanding shares of Vizsla Royalties Corp., adding 2.0%-3.5% uncapped, life-of-mine net smelter return royalties over Vizsla Silver's Panuco silver-gold project in Mexico. Vizsla shareholders elected per-share consideration of C$4.13 cash, 0.15 Elemental shares, or a combination, prorated to a C$82 million cash cap; Elemental issued about 8,107,478 shares, leaving former Vizsla holders with roughly 11.19% ownership. The arrangement was approved under the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia) following Vizsla's June 9, 2026 management information circular; Vizsla shares delist from the TSX Venture Exchange around September 16, 2026 and cease OTCQX quotation, with reporting-issuer status to end. Watch integration, Panuco permitting and production timeline, Mexican jurisdiction risk, and any post-closing share overhang from new Elemental holders.
